coverage.note: The Québec register resolves current legal identity, trade name, merger and shareholder, with Accelleron and ISED preserving acquisition lineage; the published founded_year remains nullable for reviewer judgment.
The Québec register and ISED support the current Montreal principal establishment and Canadian operating lineage.
Current TNM and Accelleron sources distinguish OptiNav voyage optimization, direct-request services and emissions reporting.
Product documents identify inputs, models, objectives, outputs, human review and API examples while preserving architecture gaps.
Commercial availability, CORS recognition, COFCO service proof and parent-reported trial evidence exist, but independent product metrics and whale-feature deployment do not.
COFCO disclosures and the Mitacs project provide named customer-service and research-program evidence with bounded scopes.

attempts: Found zero exact-name federal True North Marine contracts and excluded unrelated Accelleron Canada turbocharger or generic ship-service contracts from OptiNav adoption evidence.
coverage.note: Exact-name federal searches found no TNM contract or grant, and unrelated Accelleron Canada marine-service contracts do not prove OptiNav adoption.
Whale Guardians, IVADO and Mitacs provide durable partnership or program evidence; no unsupported financing amount is proposed.
Accelleron's current digital-team page supplies the public contact route and Montreal business phone.
The June 29 partner update supersedes the older wording with API testing while retaining the production-readiness boundary.
Evidence spans authoritative registry and government sources, company documents, independent customer disclosures, partners, research programs and a professional society.
The refresh resolves legal-name and API-testing chronology while retaining differing performance denominators, customer-proof and production-status caveats.

saturation.stopReason: Final current product and media plus independent customer, certification and exact-name procurement passes yielded no new candidate-changing claim after the registry and June 29 API-testing evidence.

warnings: The Québec register confirms the legal merger and current trade name, but reviewed public sources do not explain how legacy TNM contracts, customer notices or data-controller obligations transitioned.
Sea Cargo Charter confirms the COFCO service-provider relationship but does not independently validate Accelleron's 13-voyage fuel, emissions or cost-savings figures or their baseline.
Whale Guardians reports that its API is live and under Accelleron testing; this does not establish a production OptiNav feature, customer deployment or measured effectiveness.
No named government or defence OptiNav customer, public-sector trial, security accreditation, classified-data handling, naval integration or regulatory certification was found.

Public product sources identify inputs and API examples but not API schemas, authentication, authorization, data residency, retention, offline operation, availability, service levels or complete integration dependencies.
The IMarEST nature-routing case is a simulation under stated assumptions, not an operational deployment or a forecast of customer outcomes.
Historical IVADO beta savings, current vendor headline figures and Accelleron's COFCO trial use different samples and should not be combined into one performance claim.
